Ținutul creaturilor ciudate
programme.desc: Aceasta este povestea unei zile din viața unei familii de indri, urmărind o mamă, un tată și pe cei trei pui ai lor în jurul sălașului lor din pădurea tropicală din parcul național Mantadia din Madagascar.

programme.title: India sălbatică
programme.desc: Un pui de leu trebuie să supraviețuiască, atunci când familia sa este destrămată; doi pui de leopard adolescenți trebuie să se descurce singuri după ce sunt abandonați, iar un tânăr mascul de antilopă indiană trebuie să riște totul, încercând să se împerecheze pentru prima oară.

programme.title: India sălbatică
programme.desc: Rajan este un mascul puternic aflat în fruntea unei cete neobișnuit de mari. S-a descurcat bine, reușind să conducă un grup atât de mare, dar viitorul nu pare prea luminos. Sunt multe guri de hrăni, iar jungla în care trăiesc se micșorează.

programme.title: India sălbatică
programme.desc: Aflate la marginea străvechiului oraș Jodhpur, luxoasele grădini ale templului găzduiesc o ceată uriașă de languri cenușii care se bucură de o viață tihnită, prosperă, însă ceata are o ierarhie strictă.

programme.title: India sălbatică
programme.desc: În pădurile tropicale calde și umede din sudul Indiei, o femelă de cobră regală are o misiune. Trebuie să găsească un partener, hrană și să depună ouă, toate acestea înainte de sosirea musonului, peste cinci luni. Nu e singura; pentru multe animale din junglă, acesta este sezonul reproductiv, când masculii concurează pentru atenția femelelor, sperând să găsească un partener. Vor obține toți ceea ce vor și vor asigura viitorul generației următoare, înainte de sosirea ploilor?

programme.title: India sălbatică
programme.desc: În pădurile din sudul Indiei, căldura necruțătoare a verii le face probleme elefanților asiatici, care trebuie să bea în fiecare zi. Pe când apa începe să dispară în jurul ei, o matriarhă bătrână, înțeleaptă, pe nume Anura, decide că e timpul să-și conducă familia în migrația anuală, ca să-i asigure supraviețuirea. Călătoria ei e cu atât mai importantă cu cât turma are un membru nou, nepotul ei de trei luni, Navin. Aceasta ar putea fi una dintre ultimele ei șanse de a se asigura că le va transmite membrilor mai tineri ai familiei sale toate cunoștințele acumulate timp de o viață.

programme.title: Imperiile animalelor
programme.desc: Zboruri impresionante, călătorii aventuroase pe mare și parcursurile extenuante pe uscat, toate acestea joacă un rol esențial în viața multor specii. Aceste imperii călătoresc în căutare de hrană, adăpost sau parteneri. Dar planificarea călătoriilor nu este ușoară, mai ales când implică sute sau chiar mii de indivizi.

programme.title: Bandele de lemuri
programme.desc: Cum se apropie sezonul secetos, pe Insula lemurilor, tensiunile cresc. Privește de pe câmpul de luptă femelele cum își apără cu înverșunare teritoriul, în timp ce puii lor nou-născuți se agață de ele ca să fie în siguranță.

programme.title: Bandele de lemuri
programme.desc: Pe măsură ce mâncarea și apa se împuținează, Crystal, conducătoarea feroce a bandei Ruins, pune ochii pe teritoriul rivalei sale Kati și pe pomii fructiferi învecinați. Priviți ce pățește unul dintre grupurile de lemuri în urma mișcării adoptate de Crystal și a unui atac inițiat de niște invadatori externi.

programme.title: Bandele de lemuri
programme.desc: Seceta a trecut într-un final, însă traversarea pădurii în căutare de hrană încă presupune un risc. Totuși, puteți privi cum își asumă riscul câțiva lideri care își lasă nesupravegheate propriile teritorii pentru a se înfrupta cu cicade. Când se întorc, intrușii sunt pregătiți de luptă.

programme.title: Bandele de lemuri
programme.desc: Pe măsură ce bebelușii cresc, în fiecare grup de lemuri izbucnesc noi lupte pentru putere. Urmăriți cum își dispută poziția fiecare membru, de la Regina Crystal, femela lemur cea mai feroce, până la Erica, o femelă lemur de cel mai jos rang. În tot acest timp, bebelușii încep să înțeleagă care este rolul aliaților și al dușmanilor în modelarea propriului viitor.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Vezi călătoria evolutivă a urșilor bruni, de la strămoșii care au dominat erele glaciare până la omnivorii moderni de astăzi. Fii martor la relația lor simbiotică cu somonul și la ecosistemele surprinzător de interconectate în care prosperă.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Urmărește călătoria rinocerului negru și vezi cum adaptarea și conservarea au influențat evoluția unui titan antic al naturii. Admiră auzul extraordinar, simțul mirosului și alte avantaje biologice ale acestui erbivor blindat.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Admiră una din cele mai iconice, dar neînțelese specii de megafaună din Africa: hipopotamul. Intră în mijlocul unei confruntări și vezi cât de fatală poate fi mușcătura unui mascul teritorial, apoi fii martor la miracolul nașterii lor sub apă.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Înțelege cum adaptabilitatea a ajutat caimanul, o creatură la fel de veche ca dinozaurii, să evolueze pentru a înfrunta lumea. Vezi fluturii care se hrănesc cu lacrimile lor, apoi minunează-te de devotamentul matern demonstrat în creșele lor.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Iată ce ar putea face planetei noastre un declin global al insectelor. Descoperiți dependența noastră istorică de aceste mici animale, rolurile vitale pe care le joacă în ecosistemele noastre și de ce relația noastră fragilă cu ele este în pericol.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Aflați cum albinele, fluturii, moliile și alți polenizatori mențin câmpurile și pădurile roditoare. Cum ar fi viața fără aceste insecte ocupate ? Urmăriți un misterios pelerinaj al fluturilor și cum scapă o molie de liliecii înfometați.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Înfruntați insecte prădătoare făcute pentru a ucide. Vedeți de ce terifianta călugăriță are agilitatea unui specialist în arte marțiale și un apetit pentru orice, de la muște la colibri, apoi vânați în aer cu libelulele mortale.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Vezi călătoria evolutivă a urșilor bruni, de la strămoșii care au dominat erele glaciare până la omnivorii moderni de astăzi. Fii martor la relația lor simbiotică cu somonul și la ecosistemele surprinzător de interconectate în care prosperă.

programme.title: Misterele evoluției
programme.desc: V-ați întrebat vreodată de ce mandrilii au fețe atât de colorate, de ce vulturii sunt pleșuvi sau chiar de ce rechinii ciocan au...ei bine...cap în formă de ciocan? Descoperiți cum anume au reușit animalele să supraviețuiască dezvoltându-se de la gât în sus.

programme.title: Rezervații naturale din oceane
programme.desc: Reciful Mesoamerican e un ecosistem oceanic superv - dar, după decenii de pescuit excesiv și de activități turistice, mare parte din el este în pericol. Aceste parcuri sunt monitorizate de susținători ai oceanelor care vor să conserve teritoriile în care se hrănesc rechinii, populațiile de țestoase și teritoriile în care se reproduc viețuitoarele marine, care delimitează acest sistem de recife incredibil.

programme.title: Ținutul creaturilor ciudate
programme.desc: Filmul acesta face turul insulei, vizitând unele dintre cele mai uluitoare peisaje, pentru a analiza evoluția în timp a unor specii din Madagascar. Madagascar este o lume de o frumusețe stranie, unic, cu o diversitate uimitoare de habitate și cu peisaje deosebite.

programme.title: Orizonturile sălbatice ale Africii
programme.desc: Un peisaj stâncos, modelat de-a lungul veacurilor de vânt, apă și foc, asta reprezintă munții Cederberg din Africa de Sud. Aceste vârfuri impunătoare adăpostesc o diversitate incredibilă de plante și animale. Unele sunt încă nevăzute, bântuie în umbră și sunt gata să atace în orice moment.

programme.title: Orizonturile sălbatice ale Africii
programme.desc: Deșertul Namib este un ținut al extremelor, de la oceanul înghețat la nisipul încins. Supraviețuirea în acest deșert necesită rezistență și adaptare, de care puține viețuitoare sunt capabile. De la vipera care atacă pe furiș la gândacul care adună ceață, fiecare animal are trucurile sale pentru a supraviețui în deșertul Namib.

programme.title: Orizonturile sălbatice ale Africii
programme.desc: Deșertul Namib este cel mai vechi din lume, întinzându-se pe coasta Africii pe o lungime de peste 400 km. Este unul dintre cele mai neospitaliere habitate de pe Terra. Totuși, cel mai mare mamifer terestru e la el acasă aici, adaptându-se prin comportament și făcut să trăiască în condiții extreme.

programme.title: Orizonturile sălbatice ale Africii
programme.desc: Pe insulele stâncoase din largul coastei sud-africane, mii de animale se adună ca să se înmulțească. Printre ele se impun uriașele colonii de gâște-de-mare. Înconjurate de ape bogate în hrană, au destule resurse pentru a se hrăni și ele, și puii lor. Viața e însă plină de provocări pentru gâștele-de-mare care se reproduc...

programme.title: Orizonturile sălbatice ale Africii
programme.desc: Provincia Eastern Cape investește mult în ecoturism și conservare, ca alternativă la pescuit și la dezvoltarea comercială. Regiunea revendică terenuri agricole și închide zone de pescuit, rezervându-le animalelor sălbatice. Este una dintre cele mai entuziasmante povești ale succesului conservării în Africa.

programme.title: Insula macacilor
programme.desc: Dați-vă puțin la o parte atunci când scandalul erupe la constatarea Trupei din stradă că Trupa din deal le-a încălcat teritoriul. Evaluați calitățile îndoielnice de părinte ale lui Matnoor, urmăriți-l pe pretendentul Ajit încercând marea cu degetul, iar apoi răcoriți-vă în pădure împreună cu cei care se refugiază din fața valului de căldură.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Faceți cunoștință cu Winston, un mic pui abandonat care o impresionează pe Judy, care îl îngrijește 24 de ore din 24, 7 zile din 7. Ea rupe legătura emoțională și îl învață pe acest micuț cum să fie un urs adult și independent în lumea non-umană.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Surorile Xiba, Xyla și Xola sunt un trio de orfani înfometați care îi dau lumea peste cap lui Winston, înainte ca blânda Xola să-i dea o lecție despre prietenie. Noii pui Yasmine și Yara se reîntâlnesc după o separare stresantă.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Winston și surorile X se mută în noua lor incintă cu aer curat. Urmăriți lupta pentru putere de la grădiniță dintre Yasmine și Yara, apoi pe Victor, neliniștitul pui de un an, a cărui șchiopătare bruscă îi amână data eliberării.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Yasmine și Yara se bucură de ploaie și de cățărat, iar Winston face o baie în noua sa piscină. Mergeți la vânătoare cu Roger și Steve și vedeți ce se întâmplă când cele două grupuri de pui de vară se întâlnesc față în față.

programme.title: Ținutul cetelor de lei: renașterea sălbăticiei
programme.desc: O familie australiană pornește în aventura de a renova o veche fermă de vânătoare din Africa de Sud. Scopul lor este să refacă habitatul potopit de vegetație, să înființeze o fermă de ecoturism și să permită faunei, inclusiv prădătoarelor, să se mute iar aici.

programme.title: Prădători carpatini
programme.desc: Alăturați-vă pentru a urmări o ursoaică ce se zbate pentru a procura mâncare celor doi pui în timp ce le predă deprinderi esențiale pentru iarna grea ce urmează. Să vizităm apoi doi mici pui de râs ce se aventurează departe de siguranța bârlogului.

programme.title: Prădători carpatini
programme.desc: În zonele izolate din Munții Carpați trăiește un prădător discret ce a inspirat uimire și frică de-a lungul istoriei: lupul euro-asiatic. Descoperiți rolul vital pe care îl joacă acest vânător mult timp neînțeles în protejarea propriului ecosistem.

programme.title: Regatele sălbatice ale Europei
programme.desc: Vezi cum cea mai de seamă arhitectură a Europei a creat sanctuare pentru unele din cele mai rare specii. Mergi în Franța, Scoția și Spania, unde foci, păsări, tritoni, pisici sălbatice și șerpi prosperă printre monumente străvechi, la marginea apei.

programme.title: Secretele pădurilor fermecate
programme.desc: Urmați ecuatorul pentru a observa diferitele specii care trăiesc în pădurile tropicale. Faceți cunoștință cu un leneș singuratic dintr-o mini-pădure, lemuri care împart totul și elefanți care au grijă de grădinile lor forestiere. Apoi explorați partea întunecată a regiunii.

programme.title: Secretele pădurilor fermecate
programme.desc: Urmăriți trecerea anotimpurilor și aflați cum se ajută reciproc arborii și animelele pentru a supraviețui. Bucurați-vă de licuricii de primăvară care dansează prin noapte, descoperiți ciupercile de vară care răcoresc arborii și pregătiți-vă de toamnă odată cu căderea frunzelor.

programme.title: Secretele pădurilor fermecate
programme.desc: Descoperiți zonele umede, unde arborii și apa lucrează împreună pentru o viață nouă. Cufundați-vă într-o pădure subacvatică ce protejează puii de focă, vizitați un sanctuar de mangrove în care se ascunde un grup de animale acvatice curioase și întâlniți câțiva monștri adevărați ai mlaștinilor.

programme.title: Ținutul cetelor de lei: renașterea sălbăticiei
programme.desc: O familie australiană pornește în aventura de a renova o veche fermă de vânătoare din Africa de Sud. Scopul lor este să refacă habitatul potopit de vegetație, să înființeze o fermă de ecoturism și să permită faunei, inclusiv prădătoarelor, să se mute iar aici.

programme.title: Misterele evoluției
programme.desc: Pe scalele geologice și biologice, oamenii există pe pământ cam atât cât ar dura un clipit, și cu toate acestea am influențat calea evoluției multor animale. Explorați impactul oamenilor asupra câinilor, coioților, elefanților și asupra multor alte animale.

programme.title: Odraslele furtunii
programme.desc: Iarna se îmblânzește. În Islanda, vulpile arctice fug prin munți pentru a se împerechea. În Shetland, o vidră își crește puii. În Norvegia, o turmă de reni coboară spre locurile de fătare. O furtună uriașă de martie se dezlănțuie în Stormborn.

programme.title: Odraslele furtunii
programme.desc: Animalele din nordul Atlanticului au parte de o vară scurtă și intensă. Puii de vulpe arctică învață să vâneze pentru a supraviețui, un pui de vidră merge singur pentru prima dată, un biban își caută perechea și micii reni fac primii pași.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Admiră una din cele mai iconice, dar neînțelese specii de megafaună din Africa: hipopotamul. Intră în mijlocul unei confruntări și vezi cât de fatală poate fi mușcătura unui mascul teritorial, apoi fii martor la miracolul nașterii lor sub apă.

programme.title: Gladiatorii
programme.desc: Să-i susținem pe tinerii gladiatori care se afirmă în pădurile tropicale din America. Retrageți-vă puțin, o broască otrăvitoare lansează acum o încărcătură toxică; urmăriți un război teritorial jaguar-caiman; iată și un coati flămând care se întâlnește cu o tarantulă aflată în defensivă.

programme.title: Gladiatorii
programme.desc: Ne îndreptăm spre nordul extrem al Americii, pentru a arunca o privire la luptătorii supremi care trăiesc în preajma apelor. Iată cum dezghețul de primăvară dă startul competiției, punând față în față vulturi contra stârci, urși contra urși, și nimfe de libelulă contra unor insecte de apă gigantice și veninoase.

programme.title: Bandele de lemuri
programme.desc: Presiunea de a găsi hrană atinge noi cote și aduce multă agitație în rezervație. În plus, bandele de lemuri încep să se dezbine, determinând-o pe Crystal, liderul aprig al bandei Ruins, să se confrunte cu o situație de care nu a mai avut parte până în prezent.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Spionați puii de urs care învață să se urce în copaci și caută hrană pentru a se pregăti de eliberarea în sălbăticie. Fiți surprinși de un grup de nou-sosiți, observați ospățul de dinaintea hibernării și o Ziua a Recunoștinței prietenoasă cu urșii.

programme.title: Misterele evoluției
programme.desc: Unele dintre cele mai interesante adaptări din lumea animală sunt complet invizibile. Studiați aceste modificări interne, ascunse, pentru a vedea cât de diferit au evoluat animalele pentru a supraviețui în moduri atât de uimitoare și nemaiîntâlnite.

programme.title: Gladiatorii

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Înțelege cum adaptabilitatea a ajutat caimanul, o creatură la fel de veche ca dinozaurii, să evolueze pentru a înfrunta lumea. Vezi fluturii care se hrănesc cu lacrimile lor, apoi minunează-te de devotamentul matern demonstrat în creșele lor.

programme.title: Lumi uriașe
programme.desc: Cărăbușii locuiesc pe Terra de mai bine de 240 de milioane de ani. Există cam 380.000 de specii de cărăbuși cunoscute oamenilor de știință și în fiecare an sunt descoperite alte sute de specii noi. Un sfert din animalele lumii sunt cărăbuși. Au cucerit aproape fiecare colț și habitat de pe planetă și au supraviețuit fiecărui dezastru global. Ce anume îi face să aibă așa mare succes?

programme.title: Apele Arabiei
programme.desc: Apele oceanelor sunt pline de animale carnivore. Vedeți rechinii și pisicile de mare care patrulează în recifele de corali, în căutarea prăzii. Învățați despre peștii toxici care se deghizează ca să-i surprindă în ambuscadă pe cei neprevăzători, precum și despre prădători cu armuri care devorează prăzi vulnerabile.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta Wild Coast din Africa de Sud se întinde pe o lungime de 273 km. Aici, apele Oceanului Indian și ale Atlanticului converg, trimițând spre țărm valuri puternice. Aici, Andrea Marshal, cercetătoare din Mozambic specializată în pisici de mare, speră să conducă prima ei expediție de cercetare a pisicilor de mare de pe teritoriul Africii de Sud.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Pregătiți-vă pentru eliberarea puilor cu Roger și faceți cunoștință cu Ace și Little Blueberry, doi începători cu probleme de sănătate care vor trebui să rămână peste iarnă cu puii Z. Apoi, sărbătoriți când șase urși sănătoși își încep noua viață.

programme.title: Gladiatorii
programme.desc: Să-i susținem pe tinerii gladiatori care se afirmă în pădurile tropicale din America. Retrageți-vă puțin, o broască otrăvitoare lansează acum o încărcătură toxică; urmăriți un război teritorial jaguar-caiman; iată și un coati flămând care se întâlnește cu o tarantulă aflată în defensivă.

programme.desc: Apele oceanelor sunt pline de animale carnivore. Vedeți rechinii și pisicile de mare care patrulează în recifele de corali, în căutarea prăzii. Învățați despre peștii toxici care se deghizează ca să-i surprindă în ambuscadă pe cei neprevăzători, precum și despre prădători cu armuri care devorează prăzi vulnerabile.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta Wild Coast din Africa de Sud se întinde pe o lungime de 273 km. Aici, apele Oceanului Indian și ale Atlanticului converg, trimițând spre țărm valuri puternice. Aici, Andrea Marshal, cercetătoare din Mozambic specializată în pisici de mare, speră să conducă prima ei expediție de cercetare a pisicilor de mare de pe teritoriul Africii de Sud.

programme.title: Tabăra puilor
programme.desc: Pregătiți-vă pentru eliberarea puilor cu Roger și faceți cunoștință cu Ace și Little Blueberry, doi începători cu probleme de sănătate care vor trebui să rămână peste iarnă cu puii Z. Apoi, sărbătoriți când șase urși sănătoși își încep noua viață.

programme.title: Gladiatorii
programme.desc: Să-i susținem pe tinerii gladiatori care se afirmă în pădurile tropicale din America. Retrageți-vă puțin, o broască otrăvitoare lansează acum o încărcătură toxică; urmăriți un război teritorial jaguar-caiman; iată și un coati flămând care se întâlnește cu o tarantulă aflată în defensivă.

programme.title: Gladiatorii
programme.desc: Ne îndreptăm spre nordul extrem al Americii, pentru a arunca o privire la luptătorii supremi care trăiesc în preajma apelor. Iată cum dezghețul de primăvară dă startul competiției, punând față în față vulturi contra stârci, urși contra urși, și nimfe de libelulă contra unor insecte de apă gigantice și veninoase.

programme.title: Știința sălbăticiei
programme.desc: Înțelege cum adaptabilitatea a ajutat caimanul, o creatură la fel de veche ca dinozaurii, să evolueze pentru a înfrunta lumea. Vezi fluturii care se hrănesc cu lacrimile lor, apoi minunează-te de devotamentul matern demonstrat în creșele lor.

programme.title: Lumi uriașe
programme.desc: Cărăbușii locuiesc pe Terra de mai bine de 240 de milioane de ani. Există cam 380.000 de specii de cărăbuși cunoscute oamenilor de știință și în fiecare an sunt descoperite alte sute de specii noi. Un sfert din animalele lumii sunt cărăbuși. Au cucerit aproape fiecare colț și habitat de pe planetă și au supraviețuit fiecărui dezastru global. Ce anume îi face să aibă așa mare succes?

Jurnal de viaţă
programme.desc: O emisiune despre excelența în profesia de medic, cu invitați profesioniști în domeniul medical, oameni care performează în acest domeniu. Formatul show-ului este acela de infodoc având linia narativă a unei biografii. Scopul emisiunii este acela de a-i apropia pe campionii domeniului de publicul telespectator, de a prezenta momentele de inflexiune din cariera acestora, performanţele profesionale, planurile de viitor, predincţiile acestora în ceea ce priveşte noile descoperiri şi tendinţe în domeniul lor de expertiză şi activitate.

programme.title: Medika special 1
programme.desc: Cu: Dana Chera.

programme.title: Medika special
programme.desc: Cu: Catalina Jingoiu.

programme.title: Telemedika
programme.desc: O emisiune care va avea ca invitați medici cunoscuți care ne vor învăța cum să ne ferim de anumite boli, unde vor fi expuse particularitățile acestor boli, dar și discuții despre tipuri de patologii. Emisiunea TeleMedika are un scop educativ pentru a încerca să învețe telespectatorul să prevină apariția diverselor afecțiuni. Formatul permite interacţiunea directă între medicii invitaţi şi telespectatori prin intermediul telefonului şi a reţelelor sociale.

programme.title: Academia de sănătate
programme.desc: Academia de Sănătate este un show informativ bazat, în mare parte, pe interviuri cu renumiți profesori universitari din domeniul medical. Subiectele emisiunii sunt de actualitate şi sunt menite să ridice misterul asupra unor boli cu notorietate și să facă lumină în ceea ce privește actul medical de calitate. Domeniul medical este unul vast din toate punctele de vedere şi de aceea considerăm că introducerea în grila de programe a emisiunilor de acest tip este una benefică pentru telespectatori. În această emisiune telespectatorii au posibilitatea să fie informaţi direct de la cei ce sunt responsabili de actul medical. Formatl show-ului va încuraja dezbaterile, iar finalul va fi uşor de comunicat.

programme.desc: Haita s-a întors într-o aventură palpitantă și plină de lăbuțe, pe care o va adora întreaga familie! Toate animalele din Pădurea de Est sunt entuziasmate, pentru că regina Urs și prințesa Canue vin în vizită. Dar când lupii răi şi sălbatici amenință urșii regali, puii de lupi Stinky, Runt și Claudette sar în acțiune. Cu curaj, inteligență și mult ajutor din partea prietenilor lor sălbatici și minunați, lupii alfa și omega se ridică pentru a proteja regina și prințesa și pentru a-și salva căminul din pădure.

programme.title: Underdog
programme.desc: La Sediul Apărătorilor, membrii echipei o imploră pe Polly să le dea şi mai multe puteri şi dispozitive, când se declanşează alarma: banca a fost jefuită, dar nu există niciun semn de efracţie! programme.title: Underdog
programme.desc: Bad Dog vrea să pună stăpânire pe Capitol City cu ajutorul unui dispozitiv care îi poate adormi pe singurii care o pot opri: Apărătorii. Reuşeşte să-i adoarmă pe toţi eroii noştri... în afară de Mechapup! Fiind robot, ea nu doarme niciodată, aşa că dispozitivul nu funcţionează asupra ei... iar singurul membru al echipei care îi vedea diferenţa ca pe o slăbiciune va descoperi că e, de fapt, o forţă!

programme.title: Underdog
programme.desc: În oraş apare un robot uriaş (exact ca Mechapup, dar şi mai mare şi mov), care preia treptat toate sarcinile Apărătorilor. Underdog începe să se îndoiască de bunele intenţii ale robotului când îşi dă seama că a fost „inventat” de Simon Sinister. Într-adevăr, în scurt timp, GigaPup începe să terorizeze oraşul cu reguli exagerat de stricte. Dar vor reuşi Apărătorii să scape de acest robo-căţel uriaş, care pare să aibă toate superputerile lor, doar că mai bune? Mai ales când află că GigaPup a fost creat de... Polly!

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Ondine decide să organizeze un concert pe acoperișul clădirii în cadrul unui festival local de muzică. Singura problemă este că Ondine cântă atât de prost încât prietenii ei de la școală inventează tot felul de scuze ca să nu fie nevoiți să cânte cu ea. Ea nu are altă opțiune decât să formeze o trupă cu familia ei.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Anul acesta, fetele își petrec Crăciunul cu mamele lor, dar o furtună de zăpadă a izolat orașul și le obligă să petreacă Crăciunul cu tata... care nu a planificat nimic. Între goana fetelor după cadouri și tata care se zbate din răsputeri să pregătească o masă, acesta va fi un Crăciun pe care niciunul dintre ei nu-l va uita prea curând.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: În timp ce Ondine și Roxane caută un strop de liniște fără ca Panda să se plângă încontinuu în apartament, ele pun la cale un plan de a o împrieteni cu doamna Crochon, fără să-și imagineze vreodată că acestea vor deveni prietene cu adevărat și le vor face viața un calvar.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: E duminică. Roxane e super stresată: mâine are un test la istoria baschetului. Și, deși nu vrea să-l pice, nu pare să se poată concentra și să învețe pentru el. Anxietatea ei afectează acum întreaga familie. Tata, Ondine și Panda își dau seama că trebuie să găsească o cale să o ajute pe Roxane - altfel e de rău!

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Jaguar is not only the coolest car brand from Britain, but the coolest car brand in the world. While the manufacturer was founded as the Swallow Sidecar Company by Sir William Lyons in 1922, the first Jaguar premiered in 1935. Shortly afterwards the Jaguar SS 100 was introduced, which fascinated with its power, dynamics and elegance and thus paved the ways for models like the XK 120, the E-Type or the XJ. Car History showcases all the models from the SS 100 to the latest F-Type and looks back at Jaguar's success in motorsports.

programme.desc: In this episode we will meet the artist Christian Lapie. He is an artist who created works and installations that surprised and seduced the public. programme.title: The Edge of Art
programme.desc: Art collector Andrew Wilson teams up with curator and experiential designer Courtney Hammond to explore the uncharted waters of NFTs in the art world. As they gain a greater appreciation of the metaverse, they challenge renowned Atlanta-based artists to create a piece in the NFT domain- a medium which most have never dared to delve into before.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the city of Vallauris where Pablo Picasso became fascinated by the town and the ceramics after visiting an exhibition and it’s where he lived for a decade. The city remains forever marked by the work of this protean artist. Picasso is known in Vallauris for the chapel of the castle and its impressive cycle of paintings entitled "War and Peace". It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll be talking with Jennifer Khordi, photographer. She is a former computer professional from the Bronx. She started with street photography in the late 1980's and then moved into travel and portrait photography. She has spent the last few years photographing the moon, the Milky Way and New York City.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Giacometti, between tradition and avant-garde" at the Musée Maillol. This exhibition shows how Giacometti evolved from style to style. It tells his story from the first busts he sculpted at the age of 13, to the realization of large-scale sculptures towards the end of his life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.desc: Between 1883 and 1926 Claude Monet lived in a house at Giverny where he created a flower garden and a water garden, which provided the inspiration for his series of paintings known as the “Water Lilies”. The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Artist portrait - Quentin Carnaille
programme.desc: Born 31 years ago in Roubaix, Quentin Carnaille quickly became a force on the art scene north of France. Former architecture student, Carnaille has always been fascinated by how things work. His early works were influenced by clockwork mechanisms, he has diverted from their main use to create jewelry and accessories. It then focuses on the realization of sculptures and greater works with the same aesthetic and inspiration. The contemporary and futuristic ideas influence his work from the beginning, based on its initial orientation on the past and the origins of humanity.

programme.desc: A native of the southern French town of Grasse, Jean-Honoré Fragonard is one of the most important 18th century French painters. He studied at the French Academy in Rome but chose to be free in his work, preferring to carry out private commissions, some of which were licentious, such as “The Shirt Withdrawn” exposed at the Louvre. The “Fanciful Figure” exposed at the Louvre-Lens demonstrates an original and very modern style. One of his masterpieces is without doubt the painting “The Bolt”, in the collection of the Louvre in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Annette Messager. Her creations have been shaking up the contemporary scene for almost 50 years. She is one of the greatest French artists, awarded a Golden Lion at the Venice Biennale in 2005. She uses fabric and everyday objects to represent the intimate. But she also remains a committed artist. Installed in the popular suburbs of Paris, Annette Messager welcomes us in her workshop.

programme.title: Street Art - They Own the Day
programme.desc: From “simple” tags to gigantic, colorful murals and collages, street art that was once suppressed is now officially open to the eye of the beholder. When did this shift take place? How do artists themselves experience this change in status and perception? Has their approach evolved along with their art?\r\nTo tell these stories, we've come up with a fabulous playground: Laon's International Urban Arts festival.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Cheryl Dunn, photographer. After moving to New York City in the mid-1980s, she spent much of her career photographing the city's streets and the people who made their mark on them. In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "The Pushkin Museum: five hundred years of master drawings" at the Fondation Custodia in Paris. The works are displayed in such a way that visitors can observe the evolution of drawings over five centuries. There are drawings by the Italian artist Frederico Zuccari (or Zuccaro) but also the Dutch artist Peter Paul Rubens.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: In the heart of the Montparnasse district, the Bourdelle Museum remains one of the last testimonies of these groups of artists which flourished in Paris at the threshold of the 20th century. The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. In modern usage, the word “origami” is used as an inclusive term for all paper folding, regardless of their cultural origin. Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: When I grow up I'll be a photographer
programme.desc: In this episode, Christina, a student, is going to play the game and take pictures for a jewelry brand. We will attend a first year image analysis class. The students who did a photoshoot with a duck in the previous episode will edit the photos, and one student will organize a photoshoot on the street.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Two photographers compete on a given theme. Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, will then have to decide between them and choose the best of the two. Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will talk about the artist Antoine Bourdelle. Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Martin Schoeller, German photographer. His style is characterized by a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous. His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Move along, there's nothing to see! In April 2018, the Museum "La Piscine de Roubaix" prepared to expand its exhibition space. In a period of six months, several thousand works had to be unhooked, dusted, restored, moved, and reinstalled. These are unique works for which any handling required extreme precautions. Bruno Gaudichon, curator and founder of the museum, had to employ and bring together several workers in ordert to complete a successful reopening.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the retrospective "Tutto Ponti" which retraces 60 years of the career of the architect-designer Gio Ponti at the decorative arts museum. This is the first retrospective devoted to this Italian artist. You will discover his ceramic works from the beginning of his career, but also the furniture designs anchored in his poetic and subtle universe.

programme.title: We are Artists not Vandals
programme.desc: Born in Le Havre in 1968, CyKlop practices a playful, popular and often interactive art. He is known for his installations of urban furniture that color the city and whose offbeat poetry brings a touch of fantasy to the street. He also uses numerous supports and revisits the myth of Ulysses and the Cyclops through everyday objects that became toys, sculptures or art objects.

programme.desc: In this episode we visit the city of Vallauris where Pablo Picasso became fascinated by the town and the ceramics after visiting an exhibition and it’s where he lived for a decade. The city remains forever marked by the work of this protean artist. Picasso is known in Vallauris for the chapel of the castle and its impressive cycle of paintings entitled "War and Peace". It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll be talking with Jennifer Khordi, photographer. She is a former computer professional from the Bronx. She started with street photography in the late 1980's and then moved into travel and portrait photography. She has spent the last few years photographing the moon, the Milky Way and New York City.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Giacometti, between tradition and avant-garde" at the Musée Maillol. This exhibition shows how Giacometti evolved from style to style. It tells his story from the first busts he sculpted at the age of 13, to the realization of large-scale sculptures towards the end of his life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Suffering from mental instability, Van Gogh produced more that 2,000 paintings before committing suicide aged 37. You will discover during this visit some of his most famous masterpieces, in particularly two “Self-portraits” at the Orsay Museum, “Sunflowers” exposed at the National Gallery in London, “Starry Night” and the “Church at Auvers-sur-Oise”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

It can be a simple photograph immortalizing a movement, a dance, or even reproductions of merry-go-rounds which will remind you the period of childhood.

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

His sculptures are composed of simple geometric figures, lines, triangles, squares or circles, which float in space suspended from almost invisible threads.

This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France \r\nEnjoy your visit!

His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

The Barnes Collection in Philadelphia has more paintings by Renoir than any other gallery in the world, and it's here that we'll attempt to lift the veil on the remarkable story of this incredible artist.

programme.desc: At the top of a sloping garden, a mysterious white dome and an undulating glass facade: the House of the French Communist Party, built between 1965 and 1980 by Oscar Niemeyer. A fine example of Jean Prouvé's curtain wall façade, the extraordinary Central Committee room under the dome is one of the finest Parisian buildings of the period.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 2006, VITRA asked Herzog & de Meuron to construct a building to showcase furniture from their new HOME collection. The building is to be a museum and showroom. The architects propose a stack of 12 houses with pointed roofs. 12 different houses whose combination and interlocking create surprising spaces, both inside and out. More than an archetype, it's a house made of houses, a stroll through ever-changing architectural landscapes.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted in 1911, Pablo Picasso’s "La Coiffeuse" is an iconic work of Cubism. The painting was last seen in 1998, following a loan for an exhibition in Munich. On its return to Paris, it was stored in the Centre Pompidou’s storerooms… until the day it was discovered to be missing, in 2001. Had it been stolen from the storerooms? Sixteen years after the theft, in 2014, a ship docked at the port of Newark, in New Jersey, USA. The artwork was on board….

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top presenting pals Nicki Chapman and Jules Hudson escape to the country to find antiques with Natasha Raskin and Phillip Serrell. It becomes girls versus boys, both teams with £400 in their pockets. Kicking off from Wormsley in Herefordshire they Road Trip into Wales and Oxfordshire, before finally finishing in North Finchley, in London for an auction.\r\n\r\nAlong the way the girls meet a clog maker who carves shoes by hand. While the boys head to the Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum to hear about the regiment’s involvement at Gallipoli.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Eugène Delacroix is considered as the leader of French Romanticism, a simultaneously passionate, dramatic and tormented artistic movement, which emerged at the beginning of the 19th century. However, more than a movement, it is a whole creative and captivating artistic development, which is on offer here, through the study of 10 of the artist’s major works. He was to have a notable influence on all modern artistic movements, which after him, were to explore the power of colour and light. Discover " Liberty leading the people " or " The death of Sardanapalus " exposed at the Louvre.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: No artist captured the essence and charm of Venice better than Giovanni Antonio Canal, better known as Canaletto. This remarkable collection of over 200 paintings, drawings and etchings allows us to discover Canaletto's artistic talent, his contemporaries and the city he reproduced with genius. The film also opens the doors of two official royal residences, Buckingham Palace and Windsor Castle, to reveal more about the artist and Joseph Smith, the man who introduced Canaletto to Britain.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: They are the world’s most popular artists. The works of Cézanne, Monet, Degas and their compatriots fetch tens of millions of dollars. But just who were they really? Why and how did they paint? What lies behind their enduring appeal? \r\nTo help answer these questions, this programme secured unique access to a major exhibition focussing on the 19th century Parisian art collector Paul Durand-Ruel, the outspoken champion of Impressionism. This eagerly anticipated exhibition is perhaps the most comprehensive ever held about the Impressionists.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Exhibition on Screen takes us through the streets of Paris and then to the heart of a superb exhibition at Cambridge's Fitzwilliam Museum, whose impressive collection of Degas works is the most representative in Britain. Having benefited from exclusive access to a wide variety of rare works, the film tells the story of Degas' quest for perfection through experimentation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Discover the work of Matisse through the exhibitions at Tate Modern in London and MoMA in New York (2014) and enjoy the original performance of Royal Ballet star dancer Zenaida Yanowsky, who interprets the colors and dynamism of Matisse's painting to the jazz music of Courtney Pine. Punctuated by interviews with experts and rare archival footage of Matisse at work, this documentary will provide a special insight into the last chapter of the painter's career.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: "I envy the Japanese", wrote Van Gogh to his brother Theo. Thanks to the exhibition on which this film is based, at the Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam, we understand why. Although Vincent van Gogh never visited Japan, it remains the country that had the greatest influence on him and his work. By visiting Japanese art galleries in Paris and creating his own image of Japan after extensive research, print collections and lengthy discussions with other artists, the discovery of Japanese art took van Gogh's career in an exciting new direction.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Vocal coaches and husband and wife David and Carrie Grant are swapping singing in harmony for battling it out with antiques. With the help of experts Will Axon and Mark Stacey our competitive celebrity couple uncover some unusual items to sell at auction in rural Norfolk.\r\n\r\nDavid also visits a patch of inner-city grass in Cambridge where today children play and dogs are walked but was actually the birthplace of football, while Carrie learns how Letchworth Garden City sparked a revolution in town design.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. \r\nWatch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Painting the Holy Land
programme.desc: Lachlan Goudie follows Jesus’s last days on earth the Holy Week events that see him travel from the north of what is now Israel to Jerusalem, and the crucifixion. It’s a pilgrimage that millions undertake, and a story of love and suffering that has inspired some of the world’s most remarkable masterpieces.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Passionate about horticulture, Monet remains the undisputed master of garden painting in the history of art, but he was not alone. Artists such as Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso and Matisse used the garden as a strong theme in their work. These great artists, along with many other famous names, are brought together in an innovative exhibition from the Cleveland Museum of Art and the Royal Gallery of Arts in London. From the exhibition itself to the beauty of artists' gardens such as Monet's at Giverny, we take a journey to discover how the modern garden was used to explore radical and wondrous new ideas.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen

I, Claude Monet reveals new facets of the man who gave birth to the Impressionist movement with one painting, and who was certainly one of the most influential and renowned painters of the 19th and early 20th centuries. Shot on location across Europe, I, Claude Monet is an unprecedented, intimate film exploration of some of Western art's most beloved cult settings.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: After a two-year touring exhibition, in 2015 Girl with a Pearl Earring returned to the Mauritshuis Museum in The Hague. At 350 years old, the eternal Girl has always retained her aura of mystery and charm. The proof is in the number of curious onlookers (1.2 million) who flocked to catch a glimpse of her during her stay in Japan. The documentary seeks to uncover the many enigmas surrounding this extraordinary painting and its mysterious creator - Vermeer. Who was this girl? Why and how did Vermeer paint this picture? Come and travel back in time to discover Johannes Vermeer, visit the charming museum in The Hague and answer all these questions.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The school board of Fort de France in Martinique is the only contemporary architecture building built in Martinique but also the only administrative building naturally ventilated by the trade winds. Between the challenges of natural ventilation and the imperatives of an architectural approach, Christian Hauvette has designed a fully open building where the boundary between inside and outside disappears.

The result of the auction in Ayr all rests on a naked lady.

Admire the greatest masterpieces of this unique museum from the most remarkable Flemish painters (Van Eyck, Vermeer), French impressionists (Monet, Cézanne) and, last but certainly not least, English masters such as Hogarth and Turner.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.desc: Set on the shores of Lake Geneva, a wave of concrete and glass has inspired many metaphors since its construction: some see it as a slice of Emmental cheese, others as a molecular fabric, and still others as a moth-eaten flying carpet. The building houses a "Learning Center", a new concept for a multifunctional space dedicated to knowledge.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Vauban's "queen of citadels" is the model for the military constructions that dot France. The Lille Citadelle was built between 1668 and 1671 at the request of Louis XIV, to designs by military engineer and architect Sébastien Le Prestre de Vauban. He conceived his fortress as a response to changes in the art of warfare. Although it has lost its original function, its rigor and formal simplicity have made it a source of inspiration for great contemporary architects.

programme.desc: Secret treasures takes you on a journey to discover the unsuspected secrets and treasures of the National Assembly in France. Some of the most delicate works are kept in the greatest secrecy. But this place, which is the temple of the French democracy, opens its doors to us exceptionally today. We will make you discover this emblematic universe, more known for its political episodes than for the treasures that it shelters.

programme.desc:
Two stars of the seventies, cool crooner Tony Christie and pop royalty Jimmy Osmond are accompanied by experts Catherine Southon and Margie Cooper. Blasting off from the Leicestershire town of Loughborough they’ll head for an auction in the Staffordshire city of Stoke-on-Trent. 

Tony squeezes in a visit to Coalbrookdale, the place where ground breaking techniques were developed that kick-started the industrial revolution. And petrol-head Jimmy gets to whizz round the historical race circuit at Donington. 

The big auction finale includes a sing-a-long like no other. But which musical maestro will clinch victory?

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: David Hockney, generally considered one of Britain's most popular artists, has enjoyed worldwide success throughout his life, with exhibitions in London, New York, Paris and elsewhere attracting millions of visitors. This film reveals intimate, previously unseen interviews and focuses on two successful exhibitions that took place in 2012 and 2016 at the Royal Academy of Arts in London.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen

With complete and unprecedented access to the treasures of Amsterdam's Van Gogh Museum, this documentary sheds light on both one of the world's favorite artists and the museum's rich and unique collection. Discover these marvelous masterpieces on the big screen, while guests including world-renowned curators and art historians offer their interpretations and explanations of Van Gogh's work.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso is one of the world's greatest artists, and until his death in 1973, he was its most prolific. How did it all begin? After being ignored for too long, it's time to focus on the artist's early years and the upbringing that enabled him to achieve the extraordinary. Three cities played a key role: Malaga, Barcelona and Paris. Young Picasso traverses them and explores their influence on the artist, analyzing specific works from his early years.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, one of the most famous British painters of our time, is also one of the few twentieth-century artists to have portrayed himself so consistently in self-portraiture. His self-portraits provide a fascinating insight into both his personality and his development as a painter, from his first portrait in 1939 to his last. Through fascinating interviews with former models, friends and leading experts, this intensely captivating documentary reveals the work of a master who represents a compelling study of the dynamics of aging and the process of self-representation.

Susan discovers her inner haggler as Suzanne keeps the purse string very tight as she bids to discover an item with some real age. 

As the trip winds across Yorkshire there is the chance to meet a very special woman from Sheffield and a look around some incredible gardens with an amazing history.

Look out for Jim’s uncanny gift of guessing the age of just about anything, Dixon crossing the Niagara Falls and how to navigate by Longitude. 

Plus will the mysterious Mrs Parker turn up to the auction?

The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc:
The Centre Administratif de Pantin, a gigantic vessel of raw concrete, washed up on the banks of the Ourcq Canal in the early 1970s, in a Paris suburb known as the “Red Belt”.
Its architect, Jacques Kalisz, had not yet built anything. Sensitive to Marxist theories, he had no formal qualifications at the time. The mayor of Pantin commissioned him to design an unprecedented facility, the Cité Administrative, which was to bring together a range of administrative, social and legal services (court, social security, police station, tax office, trade union center, ANPE, morgue, kennels, etc.), all in a single location. 
20 years later, the center is deserted. It was the failure of a social utopia. The “People's Palace” is nothing but an empty shell. Destroying it would have been too expensive. So it was decided to renovate it.
In 2004, the building underwent a radical change of use: offices and employees gave way to dance companies and rehearsal studios. A new cultural center, the Centre Nat.

The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”\r\nDiscover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

As well as a gifted observer of Spanish life and its turbulent past, he is a gifted portraitist and social commentator. With Goya, the art of portraiture reached new heights. This major exhibition at London's National Gallery brings his genius back into the spotlight. Through a formidable collection of unique works and letters by Goya, we analyze the man himself and the world he painted.

programme.title: Within the frame
